content: The ultimate nature of the primordial clear light, free from extremes,The complete enjoyment body, resplendent with spontaneously present marks and signs,And the emanation body appearing in various forms according to the dispositions of beings—May the Lord of Sages, an ocean of compassion, protect us at all times!The magical dance of the wisdom, love, and power of all the Victors,For the people of Tibet, the Land of the Purgyal, you arose as their crowning glory,Gracious and supremely accomplished Lake-born Vajra,Now, we call upon you with longing; hold us with your compassion!Though you are the embodiment of the five kayas, having perfected all abandonments and realizations,And possess an equanimity that is free from any sense of partiality,Due to the powerful force of interdependence, such as the dispositions of those to be trained,You became the very protector and refuge for the beings of the Land of Snows.In particular, when King Trisong Detsen and his sonExhorted you to hold the realm of Tibet with your compassion,Since your unwavering promise remains true to its purpose,At this time, I pray that you protect us with your compassion.Destitute and tormented by the suffering of meaningless exploitation,And by the terror of false accusations, hatred, and threats to their lives,In a place that has become like the city of the Lord of Death,What wrong have the Dharma-practicing people of the Land of Snows committed?However, as a result of non-virtuous karma accumulated in the past,For more than thirty years of unbearable suffering,Reflecting on this wretched state we have endured,Look upon us with special care, O Treasury of Great Compassion!Alas! Though the power of non-virtuous karma is indeed strong,Through the power of faith, aspiration, altruistic intention, and blessings,Which are all-powerful, may the collection of all desired virtuous fruitsBe established through the power of dependent origination, so they may swiftly ripen.By the power of the Guru, the Three Jewels, and the oath-bound protectors of Tibet,And through the strength of the faith and sacred commitment of the people of the Land of Snows,Through the power of the truth of the infallible causality of appearance and emptiness,May the objects of these aspirations be swiftly accomplished!
